reason: All five V2 locked candidates failed validation without holdout access. This new experiment uses later prospective evidence and fixes every chronological boundary before reading V3 economic outcomes.
market_selection: The three signal-enabled FX markets whose authoritative IG M15 completeness exceeds 90 percent. Germany 40 is excluded because its corrected IG completeness is 95.754717 percent but remains below the governed 99 percent research threshold. No market was selected using V3 returns.
membership_source: Append-only app.prospective_opportunity_events rows whose terminal state is JOINED under AUREX_PROSPECTIVE_OPPORTUNITY_JOIN_V1 and whose decision timestamp falls inside the fixed development interval. Freeze all matching identities; do not select by return, model score, direction or policy result.
prior_v2_holdout_treatment: The V2 holdout was never accessed because every V2 candidate failed validation. Its dates may enter V3 development only under this new protocol; V2 artifacts and conclusions remain immutable.
execution_policy_source: AUREX_EXECUTABLE_ECONOMIC_PROTOCOL_V1 policy families, both directions, first broker M1 open entry and ATR14 amendment
cost_policy_source: IG_ZA_SPREAD_ONLY_NO_ROLLOVER_COHORT_V1 with frozen development-only P75 and P95 cost sensitivities; costs may not be recalibrated from validation or holdout
development_selection: At most one policy/model candidate per market. Require normal and stressed PF above 1, normal and stressed expectancy above 0 and at least 10 assessment trades on a purged chronological development split.
validation_rule: Replay the locked binary and policy without fitting or retuning. Require PF above 1 and expectancy above 0 under both frozen cost sensitivities.
holdout_rule: Holdout remains inaccessible unless the independently verified validation report passes. Replay without fitting or retuning under identical gates.
forward_shadow_rule: A holdout-passing candidate remains non-executable until prospective forward Shadow evidence meets the separately governed sample and risk requirements.
